note: I7 — written `is_current: false`, and every tool injects `is_current: true` server-side, so nothing here can answer: `lookup("SF 7.7A")` is `not_found` and `lookup("K 158")` returns only the revision 1.0 page. F9's `found_only_in_superseded` upgrade of this same evidence is closed at M8, not here, which is why the page is kept rather than deleted (§6.7).
